description: This file defines a transaction grain implementation in Orleans, including a serializable data class and a transactional grain class implementing ITransactionGrain. It manages transactional state using ITransactionalState and provides a method to perform an update.

classes.name: Info
classes.description: A serializable data class with a single integer property 'Value'.

classes.name: TransactionGrain
classes.description: An Orleans grain implementing ITransactionGrain, managing transactional state with a method to perform an update.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous update to increment the 'Value' in the transactional state.
